notes.subject: ורעה אמונה
notes.rationale: 'shepherd/feed faithfulness' (KJV 'be fed', ASV 'feed on his faithfulness') vs 'cherish/cultivate faithfulness' (JPS/BSB); I follow the latter

notes.subject: emuna
notes.rationale: אמונה 'firmness/fidelity' kept as a transliterated Hebrew term rather than reduced to one Bambara word

notes.subject: to the psalm's hearer
notes.rationale: direct imperatives: trust, do, dwell, shepherd — summons continued from v.1

notes.subject: to the faithful hearer
notes.rationale: second-person imperatives address the one tempted to envy the wicked

translation: Yawe la i dogotiya, k'a kɛ fɛn ɲuman ye; sigi dugukolo la, ka emuna mara.
